# Next

This publication makes the original `next.pdf` source file part of the repository's publishing flow rather than leaving it as a detached binary at the repo root.

## Source document

- Original PDF: https://github.com/web4hub/web4-publisher/blob/main/next.pdf
- Google Docs source: https://github.com/web4hub/web4-publisher/blob/main/next.gdoc

## Why this fits the repo

The project is already organized around Markdown-driven publications. By adding this post, the document becomes:

- searchable through the site's publication loader
- visible in the app's publication index
- traceable in the repo's content pipeline
- aligned with the publishing architecture described in the project docs

## Context

This document appears to be a generated Google Docs PDF and is currently stored as a root-level artifact. Publishing it here gives it a stable place in the repository's Web4 publishing flow while preserving the source artifact for provenance.

## Notes

The repository is designed to treat posts as `posts/**/*.md` publications, with front matter metadata and a theme. This page provides that bridge from raw source document to a proper publication entry.
